It equals the sum of the 2 numbers

question.prompt: Which property does the geometric mean of 2 positive numbers satisfy?

solutions.explanation: \(G^2=ab\). The arithmetic mean is the one whose double equals the sum of the 2 outer terms.
solutions.title: Distinguishing geometric and arithmetic means
